title: Self-Taught
subtitle: 自學成才的；靠自己學習的
description: 自學成才的；靠自己學習的

words.meaning: 自學成才的；靠自己學習的
words.note: 當 self-taught 強調一個人主要靠自己閱讀、練習和找資料來建立知識，而不是接受正式教育時，可用 self-educated。它常形容人，也可出現在較正式的傳記語境。
words.example: He was largely self-educated and learned history through books.
words.exampleZh: 他主要靠自學成才，透過書本學習歷史。

exercises.original: She was a self-taught historian who built her knowledge by reading archives and academic books on her own.
exercises.zh: 她是一名自學成才的歷史研究者，靠自己閱讀檔案和學術書籍建立知識。
exercises.upgrade: self-educated · 自學成才的；靠自己學習的

options.explanation: self-directed = 自主學習的。可以描述學習方式，但不一定表示沒有正式教育背景。
self-educated = 自學成才的。reading archives and academic books on her own 明確表示主要靠自己建立知識。
formally trained = 受正式訓練的。和 self-taught 的核心意思相反。
autodidact = 自學者。這是名詞；若直接放在 historian 前面，詞性和結構不合。
self-made = 白手興家的／靠自己成功的。說的是成功來源，不等於自學。
unqualified = 沒有資格的。沒有正式教育不代表沒有能力或資格。

exercises.original: The biography describes him as a self-taught thinker who educated himself through years of private reading.
exercises.zh: 傳記形容他是一名自學成才的思想家，多年來靠私人閱讀教育自己。
exercises.upgrade: self-educated · 自學成才的；靠自己學習的

options.explanation: self-trained = 自我訓練的。較適合技能、職業實務或技術能力。
independent learner = 獨立學習者。是名詞片語，而且不一定完全沒有正式教師。
self-schooled = 自學的。也接近，但語氣較少見，self-educated 更適合傳記敘述。
formally educated = 受正式教育的。和 private reading on his own 不符。
self-educated = 自學成才的。years of private reading 是最直接線索。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是教育方式。

exercises.original: Without attending university, the self-taught writer developed a broad knowledge of philosophy and politics.
exercises.zh: 這名作家沒有讀大學，靠自學建立了廣泛的哲學和政治知識。
exercises.upgrade: self-educated · 自學成才的；靠自己學習的

options.explanation: self-educated = 自學成才的。without attending university + broad knowledge built independently 是典型語境。
formally trained = 受正式訓練的。和 without attending university 相反。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不能說明知識是如何學來的。
self-directed only = 只屬自主學習。太籠統，也不自然作此處固定形容詞。
unqualified = 沒資格的。缺乏大學教育不等於不合資格。
apprenticed = 當過學徒的。那反而表示有師傅指導。

words.note: autodidactic 是較正式、學術或書面的形容詞，表示知識或技能主要靠自己學習而來。它常形容 person, approach, tradition, learning。
words.example: He followed an autodidactic path into mathematics.
words.exampleZh: 他靠自學走進數學領域。

exercises.original: Her self-taught approach to painting relied on books, museum visits, and constant practice rather than formal classes.
exercises.zh: 她學畫主要靠書本、博物館參觀和持續練習，而不是正式課堂，是一種自學式方法。
exercises.upgrade: autodidactic · 自學的；自學成才的

options.explanation: self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是學習方法。
formally trained = 受正式訓練的。和 rather than formal classes 相反。
self-directed only = 自主導向。意思接近但較一般，未必表示完全自學。
autodidactic = 自學式的。approach + books/museum visits/practice + no formal classes 是典型用法。
unqualified = 沒資格的。完全不是學習方式。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。那通常有師傅指導。

exercises.original: The researcher became interested in the author's self-taught intellectual development outside universities.
exercises.zh: 研究者對這位作者在大學體制外的自學式思想發展產生興趣。
exercises.upgrade: autodidactic · 自學的；自學成才的

options.explanation: self-trained = 自我訓練的。較適合技能訓練，不如 autodidactic 適合 intellectual development。
self-schooled = 自學的。也可，但學術語境中 autodidactic 更精確正式。
autodidactic = 自學式的。intellectual development outside universities 是典型正式用法。
formally educated = 受正式教育的。和 outside universities 的重點不合。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是知識形成方式。
guided = 受指導的。和 self-taught 相反。

exercises.original: The exhibition traces the painter's self-taught development from early sketches to mature work.
exercises.zh: 展覽追溯這名畫家的自學發展，由早期素描到成熟作品。
exercises.upgrade: autodidactic · 自學的；自學成才的

options.explanation: formally instructed = 受正式指導的。和 self-taught 相反。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是藝術學習歷程。
untrained = 未受訓練的。自學者其實可能訓練非常充分，只是沒有正式老師。
independent only = 只是獨立。過於籠統。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。表示有師傅帶領。
autodidactic = 自學式的。development of an artist outside formal instruction 很自然。

words.meaning: 自行學習的；自我指導學會的
words.note: 當 self-taught 強調某人沒有教師，而是自行閱讀教材、按照說明或自己安排學習內容時，可用 self-instructed。語氣較正式。
words.example: She was self-instructed in basic accounting.
words.exampleZh: 她的基礎會計是自行學會的。

exercises.original: He was self-taught in electronics, learning from manuals and experimenting at home without a teacher.
exercises.zh: 他的電子技術是自學的，靠說明書和在家實驗，沒有老師指導。
exercises.upgrade: self-instructed · 自行學習的；自我指導學會的

options.explanation: formally trained = 受正式訓練的。和 without a teacher 相反。
guided = 受指導的。題目明確沒有老師。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。通常有師傅或工作場所訓練。
self-directed = 自主學習的。意思較廣，可能仍有課程和教師。
self-instructed = 自行學會的。manuals + experimenting alone + no teacher 是最直接線索。
self-made = 白手興家的。無關。

exercises.original: The self-taught accountant learned bookkeeping from textbooks and practice exercises at home.
exercises.zh: 這名會計靠教科書和在家練習自行學會簿記。
exercises.upgrade: self-instructed · 自行學習的；自我指導學會的

options.explanation: self-schooled = 自學的。也接近，但 textbooks + exercises 更直接像自己作為自己的老師。
self-instructed = 自我指導學會的。靠教材和練習自行掌握技能，最自然。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是學習方式。
formally educated = 受正式教育的。原句是 at home self-study。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。沒有師傅。
mentored = 有導師指導的。和 self-taught 相反。

exercises.original: She became self-taught in Latin by working through grammar books on her own.
exercises.zh: 她靠自己逐本學文法書，自學拉丁文。
exercises.upgrade: self-instructed · 自行學習的；自我指導學會的

options.explanation: self-instructed = 自行學會的。working through grammar books on her own 是典型自我指導學習。
formally taught = 受正式教授的。和 on her own 相反。
guided = 有人指導的。和 self-taught 不符。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。不適合語言學習。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。無關。
unqualified = 沒資格的。不能代表學習方式。

words.meaning: 自行訓練的；靠自己練成的
words.note: 當 self-taught 指實用技能、技術能力、表演能力或職業技能主要靠自己反覆練習而學成時，可用 self-trained。它比 self-educated 更偏技能訓練。
words.exampleZh: 他是一名靠自己訓練成才的攝影師。

exercises.original: The self-taught photographer improved by taking thousands of pictures and studying his own mistakes.
exercises.zh: 這名攝影師靠拍攝數千張照片並研究自己的錯誤來自我訓練。
exercises.upgrade: self-trained · 自行訓練的；靠自己練成的

options.explanation: self-educated academically = 學術上自學。攝影這裡更像實作技能訓練。
mentored = 有導師指導的。和 self-taught 相反。
self-trained = 自我訓練的。taking thousands of pictures + studying mistakes 明確是靠實作練成技能。
formally certified = 正式獲證書的。證書和學習方式不同。
self-made = 靠自己成功的。不是技能形成方式。
apprenticed = 當學徒的。通常有老師傅帶領。

exercises.original: She is a self-taught runner who designed her own training plan and improved without a coach.
exercises.zh: 她是一名自行訓練的跑手，自己設計訓練計劃，沒有教練也不斷進步。
exercises.upgrade: self-trained · 自行訓練的；靠自己練成的

options.explanation: formally coached = 受正式教練訓練。和 without a coach 相反。
guided = 受指導。原句沒有教練。
self-directed learner = 自主學習者。可以描述態度，但 runner 的體能訓練更自然用 self-trained。
apprenticed = 當學徒。運動語境不合。
self-made = 靠自己成功。不能精確描述訓練方式。
self-trained = 自行訓練的。own training plan + without a coach 是最明確線索。

exercises.original: The technician was self-taught and learned to repair old radios through repeated hands-on practice.
exercises.zh: 這名技術員靠反覆實作自學修理舊收音機。
exercises.upgrade: self-trained · 自行訓練的；靠自己練成的

options.explanation: self-educated broadly = 廣泛自學。意思太泛，不如 self-trained 聚焦實作技能。
mentored = 有導師指導。題目沒有。
formally trained = 正式受訓。和 self-taught 相反。
self-trained = 自行訓練的。repeated hands-on practice 是最典型線索。
self-made = 靠自己成功。不是學習方式。
unqualified = 沒資格。自學不代表沒能力或資格。

words.meaning: 自學的；靠自己教育自己的
words.note: self-schooled 是較少見但自然的書面說法，表示一個人主要靠自己讀書、觀察和實踐來建立知識。它有時帶傳記或歷史色彩。
words.example: The largely self-schooled inventor learned through reading and experimentation.
words.exampleZh: 這名發明家主要靠自己讀書和實驗學習。

exercises.original: The self-taught inventor had little formal schooling and learned mechanics through books and experiments.
exercises.zh: 這名發明家受正式教育不多，靠書本和實驗自學機械。
exercises.upgrade: self-schooled · 自學的；靠自己教育自己的

options.explanation: formally educated = 受正式教育。和 little formal schooling 不符。
self-schooled = 自學的。little formal schooling + books and experiments 是很典型的傳記式用法。
apprenticed = 當學徒。表示有人指導。
self-made = 靠自己成功。不是如何學機械。
mentored = 有導師帶領。和原句相反。
certified = 有證書。和學習方式無關。

exercises.original: He was a self-taught naturalist whose knowledge came from field observation rather than university study.
exercises.zh: 他是一名自學的博物學家，知識主要來自實地觀察，而非大學學習。
exercises.upgrade: self-schooled · 自學的；靠自己教育自己的

options.explanation: self-schooled = 自學的。field observation rather than university study 是典型靠自己教育自己的語境。
formally trained = 受正式訓練。和 rather than university study 不符。
guided = 受指導。沒有這個意思。
apprenticed = 當學徒。和自然觀察自學不同。
self-made = 白手興家的。不是教育背景。
unqualified = 不合資格。自學不等於不合資格。

exercises.original: The biography presents her as a self-taught scholar shaped more by libraries than classrooms.
exercises.zh: 傳記把她描寫成一名自學學者，受圖書館影響多於課堂。
exercises.upgrade: self-schooled · 自學的；靠自己教育自己的

options.explanation: self-made = 靠自己成功。無法表達知識來源。
apprenticed = 當學徒。通常有師傅。
formally educated = 受正式教育。和 libraries than classrooms 的對比不符。
mentored = 有導師。不是自學。
self-schooled = 自學的。libraries rather than classrooms 是最自然的線索。
certified = 有證書。與學習方式不同。

words.note: 這是自然的句子層級改寫。當 self-taught 修飾技能或知識時，可以改寫成 learned independently，強調學習過程主要由自己完成。
words.exampleZh: 她靠自己學會了程式設計。

exercises.original: He is self-taught in web design and never took a formal course.
exercises.zh: 他的網頁設計是自學的，從未修讀正式課程。
exercises.upgrade: was certified · 獨立學會；靠自己學習

options.explanation: was formally trained = 受正式訓練。和 never took a formal course 相反。
learned web design independently = 獨立學會網頁設計。完整保留 self-taught 的核心意思，而且句子很自然。
was mentored = 有導師指導。不是 self-taught。
completed an apprenticeship = 完成學徒訓練。通常有正式工作場所指導。
was self-made = 靠自己成功。不是學習過程。
was certified = 獲認證。和是否自學沒有必然關係。

exercises.original: She became a self-taught pianist by practising at home with books and recordings.
exercises.zh: 她靠書本和錄音在家練習，自學成為鋼琴手。
exercises.upgrade: learned piano independently · 獨立學會；靠自己學習

options.explanation: was formally educated = 受正式教育。和 at home self-study 不符。
was coached = 有教練／老師指導。原句沒有。
learned piano independently = 獨立學會鋼琴。books + recordings + home practice 是直接線索。
was apprenticed = 當學徒。不自然。
was self-made = 靠自己成功。不能表示如何學琴。
was licensed = 獲牌照。和學習方法不同。

exercises.original: The self-taught developer learned the language from documentation and small personal projects.
exercises.zh: 這名開發者靠文件和個人小項目自學這種程式語言。
exercises.upgrade: was apprenticed · 獨立學會；靠自己學習

options.explanation: learned independently = 獨立學會。documentation + personal projects 清楚表示沒有依靠正式老師。
was formally instructed = 受正式指導。和 self-taught 相反。
was mentored = 有導師。不是本句。
was apprenticed = 當學徒。無關。
was self-made = 靠自己成功。不是學習方式。
was assessed = 被評核。評核不等於教學。

words.meaning: 自己教自己；靠自己學會
words.note: 這是最直接的動詞改寫之一。當 self-taught 描述某人如何學會一項技能時，可改成 taught oneself + 技能／how to...。語氣自然、日常。
words.example: He taught himself how to code.

exercises.original: She is self-taught in graphic design and learned everything from online tutorials and practice.
exercises.zh: 她的平面設計是自學的，所有東西都靠網上教學和練習學會。
exercises.upgrade: taught herself graphic design · 自己教自己；靠自己學會

options.explanation: taught herself graphic design = 自己教自己平面設計。online tutorials + practice 是最自然的自學改寫。
was formally trained = 受正式訓練。和 self-taught 相反。
was apprenticed = 當學徒。通常有人帶領。
was self-made = 靠自己成功。不是學習方式。
was supervised = 受監督。不能表示自己學。
was certified = 獲認證。和自學無關。

exercises.original: He became a self-taught cook after years of experimenting with recipes at home.
exercises.zh: 他多年在家試做食譜，靠自己學會烹飪。
exercises.upgrade: taught himself to cook · 自己教自己；靠自己學會

options.explanation: was mentored = 有導師。不是自己摸索。
was formally educated = 受正式教育。沒有這個線索。
completed culinary school = 完成廚藝學校。和 self-taught 相反。
was apprenticed = 當學徒。通常在師傅指導下學。
taught himself to cook = 自己學會烹飪。years of experimenting at home 是典型自學。
was licensed = 獲牌照。與學習方法不同。

exercises.original: The self-taught mechanic learned how engines worked by taking old ones apart and rebuilding them.
exercises.zh: 這名機械技師靠拆解和重組舊引擎，自學引擎運作。
exercises.upgrade: taught himself how engines worked · 自己教自己；靠自己學會

options.explanation: was self-made = 靠自己成功。沒有表達學習內容。
taught himself how engines worked = 自己學懂引擎運作。taking engines apart and rebuilding them 是典型自學實作。
was formally instructed = 受正式指導。和 self-taught 相反。
was apprenticed = 當學徒。通常有人教。
was supervised = 受監督。不是自學。
was certified = 獲認證。認證不等於學習方式。

words.meaning: 自學者；靠自己學習的人
words.note: autodidact 是名詞，不是形容詞。當 self-taught 用來描述一個人時，可以改寫句子，稱這個人為 an autodidact。它較正式、書面。
words.example: He was an autodidact who learned several languages on his own.
words.exampleZh: 他是一名自學者，靠自己學會數種語言。

exercises.original: The self-taught philosopher learned almost entirely outside formal institutions.
exercises.zh: 這名哲學家幾乎完全在正式教育機構以外自學。
exercises.upgrade: a self-made businessman · 自學者；靠自己學習的人

options.explanation: a formally trained scholar = 受正式訓練的學者。和 outside formal institutions 相反。
an apprentice = 學徒。通常在師傅指導下學習。
an autodidact = 自學者。名詞形式非常適合重寫『self-taught philosopher』。
a self-made businessman = 白手興家的商人。職業和意思都不合。
a certified teacher = 認證教師。不是學習方式。
a mentored student = 有導師學生。和自學相反。

exercises.original: She was a self-taught artist who had never studied at an art school.
exercises.zh: 她是一名自學藝術家，從未在藝術學校讀過。
exercises.upgrade: an autodidact · 自學者；靠自己學習的人

options.explanation: a self-made person = 靠自己成功的人。不能表示自學藝術。
a guided learner = 受引導學習者。和 self-taught 不符。
a formal trainee = 正式受訓者。和 never studied at art school 相反。
an apprentice = 學徒。通常有師傅。
a certified artist = 有認證的藝術家。不是自學含義。
an autodidact = 自學者。never studied at an art school 是最直接線索。

exercises.original: The self-taught linguist acquired several languages without teachers or formal courses.
exercises.zh: 這名語言學習者沒有老師或正式課程，靠自己學會數種語言。
exercises.upgrade: an autodidact · 自學者；靠自己學習的人

options.explanation: a formally educated linguist = 受正式教育的語言學者。和 without teachers or formal courses 相反。
a mentored learner = 有導師學習者。不是自學。
an autodidact = 自學者。without teachers or formal courses 完整符合這個名詞。
an apprentice = 學徒。通常有導師或師傅。
a certified translator = 認證翻譯員。職業和意思不同。
a self-made executive = 白手興家的管理人員。完全不合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 自主學習的不等於一般的 self-taught self-directed 表示學習者自己規劃和管理學習，但仍可能參加正式課程、接受教師指導，因此不一定等於 self-taught。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A self-directed learner may still have teachers; a self-taught learner mainly learns without formal instruction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 白手興家的；靠自己成功的不等於一般的 self-taught self-made 描述成功、財富或地位主要靠自己取得，不表示知識或技能是自學而來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A self-made entrepreneur is not necessarily self-taught.

falseSynonyms.zh: 未受訓練的不等於一般的 self-taught untrained 表示沒有接受訓練；self-taught 則表示雖沒有正式老師，但自己確實學習和訓練過。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A self-taught musician may be highly skilled, not untrained.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不合資格的；沒有資格的不等於一般的 self-taught self-taught 只描述學習方式，並不表示沒有專業能力、證書或資格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A self-taught programmer may still be highly qualified.

falseSynonyms.zh: 非正式的不等於一般的 self-taught informal 可以形容學習環境或方式，但不代表一定是自己學；非正式學習也可能有人教。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Informal learning can still involve instruction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 業餘的；非職業的不等於一般的 self-taught amateur 表示不是以某活動為職業，和是否自學沒有直接關係。很多專業人士也是 self-taught。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A self-taught artist can become a professional artist.

falseSynonyms.zh: 當過學徒的不等於一般的 self-taught apprenticeship 通常包含師傅或工作場所中的系統指導，因此不等於 self-taught。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An apprentice learns under guidance; a self-taught learner learns mainly independently.

falseSynonyms.zh: 天生有才華的不等於一般的 self-taught 有天分和自學是兩回事。self-taught 描述學習途徑，不是天賦來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Talent may help learning, but self-taught describes how the skill was learned.
